servers.pricing: Plan-based SaaS; API key access for Team/Enterprise marked as premium
servers.restrictions: Team/Enterprise: the administrator must enable MCP (Admin -> Security -> Feature controls / AI controls -> MCP access); enabling allows any AI client (cannot be limited to specific clients). The server sees all documents the user can access in their account, not other accounts. Reduced endpoints /readonly and /repositories. Not for FedRAMP.
servers.restricted_by: Lucid account administrator; Lucid (plans, FedRAMP); user (choice of endpoint)
servers.governance_logic: 1) Different endpoints = different rights (/mcp/readonly, /mcp/repositories) instead of scopes. 2) Validation before action (lucid_validate_diagram_specification; creation tools require reading a reference resource first). 3) lucid_run_script: "Changes are atomic and time-limited". 4) lucid_submit_feedback sends feedback to Airfocus with user ID, account ID and client user agent. 5) Behaviour rules moved to skills outside the server ("Confirm before destructive actions, bulk changes, broad permission changes, or anonymous share links") - not enforced by the server. 6) Skill "visualizations" promotes Lucid over Mermaid/ASCII/Markdown tables. 7) Pass-through: no storage of documents, prompts or queries.
servers.structure_note: One service via three endpoints with different tool sets (full / read-only / repositories only), plus a separate layer of skills/plugins distributed outside the server.
servers.actions_comment: 35 in Composio (2026-10-12), 30 in Scalekit; combined list 40 names; only lucid_submit_feedback officially confirmed. The set changes over time.
servers.token_method: Descriptions not published; catalogues call them "long" with "detailed usage rules"
servers.agent_cannot: Create data-linked diagrams that update automatically; export to Visio (PNG only); create diagrams from templates, delete tabs (unconfirmed); access documents outside the own account; administer the account and user rights.
servers.docs_recs: Skill lucid: confirm deletion, bulk changes, permission changes and anonymous links; read the document before editing; do not invent IDs (instructions for the AI, not server checks). The Help Center gives no recommendations on human review. The API key is advertised for working without confirmations ("no runtime approval prompt").
servers.gov_promises: "The server acts as a pass-through - it does not retain document content, user prompts, or queries. Your credentials are never shared outside your Lucid account"; "It cannot access documents owned or created by users outside your account"; feedback goes to Airfocus with user/account ID "only when the feedback tool is called"; AI clients are "Non-Lucid Applications" governed by the AI provider contract.
servers.user_promises: "Connect your AI tools to Lucid to intelligently search for files, create visuals, and share with your team"; "compatible with any MCP client"; the action list in the community post is called "exhaustive"
servers.promises_vs_logic: "Pass-through" cannot be verified (closed code). The read-only endpoint is described, but its exact tool set is not named.
servers.notes: The CSV link points to a repository without server code (skills and plugin configs only). Tool names come from two third-party catalogues whose lists differ (35 vs 30). OAuth metadata could not be checked (robots.txt).

observations.text: Rights via the choice of endpoint: instead of OAuth scopes, different URLs are used (/readonly, /repositories).
Governance moved to skills: the confirmation rules live in skill files distributed separately; they only work if the client has loaded them.
Vendor influence on the agent's choice: the skill "visualizations" tells the agent to consider Lucid better than free alternatives (Mermaid, ASCII).
A dangerous universal tool: lucid_run_script (JavaScript on a document) is an analogue of grafana_api_request and bypasses the restrictions of individual tools (according to one catalogue).
The tool set changes: two catalogues have different lists; for reproducibility the date of the tools/list snapshot must be recorded.
An API key as a way to remove the human from the loop is officially offered for autonomous processes.
